module_summary: Small classic-shell helpers split out of the uLE filer: gui_colors.c saves/parses the colour and screen keys of LAUNCHSTATION.CNF, gui_hdd0_format.c turns hddN:/dvr_hdd0: browser paths into a partition name plus pfs/dvr_pfs path, gui_sort.c is the filer comparator and quicksort, gui_texteditor.c decides whether the Open in Text Editor action is offered. gui_neutrino.c builds Neutrino command-line options, shows the launch-options menu (a dashboard modal plus the older classic dialog) and stores per-game option profiles in two versioned NEUT-<id>-A/B.CNF slots. hdd_header_injector.c reads/writes the APA partition header (raw sector devctl) to inject PS2ICON3D attribute files from a __Headers/<partition>/ folder on USB/MMCE/UDPFS, copies optional PFS files, and edits the header SYSTEM.CNF through a temporary file and a text editor callback. hdl_rpc.c is the EE client of the hdl_info IRX (game info and rename RPC). init.h is the prototype list for src/init.c driver loading, IOP reset and network/server control; every prototype in it has a definition and at least one user.

reusable_helpers.name: getHddParty
reusable_helpers.what: splits an hddN:/partition/path (plus optional FILEINFO) into "hddN:partition" and "pfs0:/path"

reusable_helpers.name: getHddDVRPParty
reusable_helpers.what: same split for dvr_hdd0: paths, resolving the dvr_pfsN mount index

reusable_helpers.name: cmpFile
reusable_helpers.what: FILEINFO comparator: folders first, ELF first, by name/title/date, case-insensitive, honours descending flag

reusable_helpers.name: sort
reusable_helpers.what: recursive quicksort of a FILEINFO array using cmpFile

reusable_helpers.name: hddHeaderJoinPath
reusable_helpers.what: joins dir and file with a single '/' and reports truncation (static)

reusable_helpers.name: hddHeaderReadSector
reusable_helpers.what: reads one raw HDD sector via HDIOC_READSECTOR devctl (static); hddHeaderWriteSector at line 438 is the write twin

reusable_helpers.name: buildNeutrinoOptionArgs
reusable_helpers.what: validates Neutrino launch options and encodes them as -gc/-gsm/-dbc/-logo argv strings

findings.title: Hdl_Inited survives IOP reboots, so HdlGetGameInfo can call a stale hdl_info RPC client
findings.problem: clearIopModuleState (called by Reset, init.c:3066) clears have_hdl_info (init.c:2998) but nothing clears hdl_rpc.c's Hdl_Inited. After the HDD manager has loaded hdl_info once, any IOP reboot (stack switch, rebootIopAndReloadCoreStack) leaves Hdl_Inited=1, so dash_hdd.c hdlReady returns 1 without reloading the module and loadGameInfo calls HdlGetGameInfo -> SifCallRpc on a client bound to a server that no longer exists. Hdl_Info_BindRpc also sets Hdl_Inited=1 when its retry loop times out, and init.c:2571 ignores the result. Three flags (have_hdl_info, Hdl_Inited, the static 'tried' in hdlReady) track one state.
findings.fix: Make one flag the truth: set Hdl_Inited only when client.server != 0, clear it in clearIopModuleState next to have_hdl_info (or drop Hdl_Inited and let loadHdlInfoModule return the bind result), and delete the static 'tried' in hdlReady since loadHdlInfoModule is already idempotent through have_hdl_info.
findings.justification: Adds one reset line (or a return value); it fixes a reachable stale-RPC call after an IOP reboot and removes the redundant 'tried' flag, so the line count stays about even.
findings.benefit: Removes a possible EE hang or IOP crash on HDD manager use after an IOP reboot (consequence of calling a dead RPC server is INFERRED); ~4 lines net removed.
findings.evidence: Read hdl_rpc.c:24-83, init.c:2563-2574 (loadHdlInfoModule ignores Hdl_Info_BindRpc ret), init.c:2965-3004 clearIopModuleState sets have_hdl_info=0 only, Reset init.c:3048-3066 calls it. Grep Hdl_Inited over src: hdl_rpc.c:24,48,57,74 and dash_hdd.c:419,425,436 only; no reset. dash_hdd.c:421-449 hdlReady/loadGameInfo. The hang/crash on SifCallRpc to a vanished server is INFERRED, not tested on hardware.

findings.title: Classic Neutrino options dialog is only reachable before DashRun (hand-edited IGR after-app path)
findings.problem: showNeutrinoLaunchOptions uses the dashboard modal whenever DashIsActive(). dash_active is set at DashRun entry (dash_main.c:1349) and cleared only at exec cleanup (dash_main.c:316); DashRun is the only shell (main.c:293-307). The only launch before DashRun is runWleIgrAfter (main.c:221-243), whose app path comes from a picker limited to ELF (dash_settings.c:2074), so the classic pad loop, its draw helpers and moveNeutrinoSelection run only if a user hand-edits DASHBOARD.CNF to point the IGR after-app at an ISO. The comment at 348-350 still says the classic shell uses it.
findings.fix: Delete moveNeutrinoSelection, drawNeutrinoHeading, drawNeutrinoOption and the classic loop; when DashIsActive() is false return TRUE with the zeroed (default) options, which matches the existing no-profile launch-only defaults. Keep the enum values so NEUTRINO_CANCEL row indexes used by the dashboard menu do not shift, and update the source-text anchors in tests/test_r3z_neutrino_options.py:37 and tests/test_system_clock_menu.py:37.
findings.benefit: ~110 source lines removed; the static functions and the loop are live code today, so the ELF shrinks by their size (INFERRED, roughly 1-2 KB of .text plus format strings).
findings.evidence: Grep dash_active= : dash_main.c:316,1349 only. Grep LaunchNeutrinoIso( : main_actions.c:347 only, reached from ExecuteMainAction; callers of ExecuteMainAction: dash_main.c:442,669, main_actions.c:250, main.c:265 (Execute, called only from runWleIgrAfter main.c:227,240). igr_after_path is set by dash_settings.c:2074 (ext ELF) or parsed raw from DASHBOARD.CNF (dash_store.c:376). moveNeutrinoSelection, drawNeutrinoHeading/Option, NEUTRINO_RUN used only inside gui_neutrino.c classic part (grep over repo); tests reference drawNeutrinoHeading as a text anchor.

findings.title: Neutrino game profiles use two versioned slots, a checksum and a second full re-read after dashWriteFile already verifies
findings.problem: Each ~70-byte per-game options record is kept as NEUT-<id>-A.CNF and -B.CNF with a revision number and FNV checksum; a save reads both slots, writes the older one, then profileReadLatest re-reads and re-parses both slots to verify. dashWriteFile already re-opens and byte-compares the written file (dash_store.c:163-174), and losing a profile on an interrupted write only means the game launches with default options.
findings.fix: Store one NEUT-<id>.CNF written with dashWriteFile and read with dashLoadTextFile; delete profileChecksum, profileReadLatest, the slot/revision logic and the post-write re-read. Keep the strict sscanf/range validation. Old A/B files are simply ignored (or read the -A name once if migration matters). Update tests/test_neutrino_profiles.py.
findings.benefit: ~50 lines removed; one memory-card file per profiled game instead of two (each MC file costs a directory entry and at least one 1 KB cluster, INFERRED), and a save does 1 write + 1 verify read instead of 2 reads + 1 write + 3 reads.
findings.evidence: Read gui_neutrino.c:93-261 and dash_store.c:105-175. profileSave (232-261) calls profileReadLatest before and after dashWriteFile; profileReadLatest calls profileReadSlot twice. Grep profileChecksum/NTP1/NEUT-: only gui_neutrino.c and tests/test_neutrino_profiles.py:33.

findings.title: hdd_header_copy_buffer keeps 32 KB of .bss for a rare header-injection copy while a 2 MB heap buffer was just freed
findings.problem: The static 32768-byte copy buffer is used only by hddHeaderCopyOptionalPfsFile during InjectHddPartitionHeaderFromSource. That function memaligns the 2 MB hdd_header_buffer and frees it (1150) immediately before calling hddHeaderCopyOptionalPfsFiles (1155), so the 32 KB stays reserved for the whole session for no reason.
findings.fix: Delete the static buffer and HDD_HEADER_COPY_BUFFER_SIZE; free hdd_header_buffer after the PFS copy instead of before it and use its first 32 KB (or all of it) as the copy buffer.
findings.benefit: 32,768 bytes of EE .bss freed (MEASURED: BUILD-EVIDENCE.md:91 lists hdd_header_injector.o .bss 33,920; the copy buffer is 32,768 of it); no extra allocation; ~2 lines removed.
findings.evidence: Grep hdd_header_copy_buffer: hdd_header_injector.c:89,1045,1054 only. Read 1103-1160: memalign 1142, free 1150, copy 1155. evidence/Launchstation/BUILD-EVIDENCE.md:91 .bss figure.

findings.title: SYSTEM.CNF temp-file editing reimplements dashWriteFile/dashLoadTextFile and probes up to 100 temp names
findings.problem: hddHeaderWriteTempFile + configEnsureSysconfDir (850) is what dashWriteFile does (dash_store.c:154-162, plus read-back verify), and hddHeaderReadTempFile is a bounded whole-file read like dashLoadTextFile. Four helpers repeat the same 'genFixPath or copy the raw path' fallback (698-701, 722-725, 761-764, 800-803), and hddHeaderBuildTempPath opens up to 100 WLEHCnn.TMP names on the card although the edit runs synchronously on the UI thread with the worker idle (dash_hdd.c:960-966).
findings.fix: Use one fixed temp name built with configBuildSysconfPath, write it with dashWriteFile, read it back with dashLoadTextFile(path, APA_HEADER_SYSTEM_CNF_MAX_SIZE, &len), remove it with genRemove. Delete hddHeaderWriteTempFile, hddHeaderReadTempFile, hddHeaderTempFileExists, hddHeaderBuildTempPath, hddHeaderRemoveTempFile and the TEMP_FILE_FORMAT/TRIES macros.
findings.benefit: ~100 lines removed (117 lines of helpers replaced by ~10 calls); fewer memory-card opens per edit (no name probing). INFERRED.
findings.evidence: Read hdd_header_injector.c:689-871 and dash_store.c:105-175; dashWriteFile/dashLoadTextFile declared in include/dash_internal.h:667-668 and linked in the same ELF. Grep hddHeaderBuildTempPath/hddHeaderWriteTempFile/hddHeaderReadTempFile: only hdd_header_injector.c. Only caller of EditHddPartitionHeaderSystemCnf is dash_hdd.c:966 (UI thread after dashWorkerAwaitAll).

findings.title: Two near-duplicate function pairs in hdd_header_injector.c: the source wait loops and the raw-range read/write
findings.problem: hddHeaderWaitForSourceRoot and hddHeaderWaitForSource are the same 21-line timed loop except for the probe call and the message. hddHeaderReadRawRange and hddHeaderWriteRawRange share the same bounds checks and sector walk (15 normalised lines per the duplicate report); the write side only adds a memcpy direction and a write-back.
findings.fix: Make one wait loop that takes the partition name (NULL meaning the __Headers root) and one raw-range function with a write flag.
findings.benefit: ~35 lines removed; static functions, small .text saving (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read both pairs side by side. evidence dupes-blocks.tsv: 564-582 == 594-612. Callers: WaitForSourceRoot from HddHeaderListSourcePartitions:355, WaitForSource from InjectHddPartitionHeaderFromSource:1121, ReadRawRange from hddHeaderReadSystemCnf:644, WriteRawRange from hddHeaderWriteSystemCnf:674.

findings.title: boot.kelf/BOOT.KELF fallback is hand-coded three times and the header file is stat-opened, sized and re-opened
findings.problem: hddHeaderSourceHasFile (154-159) and hddHeaderReadFileIntoHeader (887-892) each special-case the string "boot.kelf" to retry "BOOT.KELF", and ReadFileIntoHeader retries it a third time after genOpen fails (903-909) although the path already holds the name whose size was just read. hddHeaderGetFileSize opens the file only to lseek, then ReadFileIntoHeader opens it again. The PFS table already has an alternate_source_name field for the same need (48, 81).
findings.fix: Add an alternate name to HddHeaderFileSpec ("BOOT.KELF" for boot.kelf), resolve it with the existing hddHeaderOpenOptionalSourceFile, take the size with lseek on that fd and read from it. Delete the three strcmp("boot.kelf") branches and the separate open in hddHeaderGetFileSize where it is used for reading.
findings.benefit: ~20 lines removed; one open per header file instead of two or three (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read hdd_header_injector.c:116-166, 873-982. Grep "boot.kelf" in src: hdd_header_injector.c:73,154,887,903 only. hddHeaderOpenOptionalSourceFile at 946 already tries a primary and alternate name.

findings.title: Defensive NULL/empty checks and redundant NUL stores in static hdd_header_injector.c helpers
findings.problem: Every listed function is static and every caller passes a stack array, a static buffer or an argument the public entry already validated (350, 1112-1115), so the NULL checks cannot fire. The source_dir[size-1]='\0' stores follow snprintf, which always terminates.
findings.fix: Delete these checks and stores; keep the validation in the three public entry points.
findings.benefit: ~32 lines removed; a few dozen bytes of .text (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read every caller inside hdd_header_injector.c (all helpers are static; grep of each name over src finds only this file). Public entries HddHeaderListSourcePartitions:350 and InjectHddPartitionHeaderFromSource:1112-1115 validate source_device/partition_name; dash_hdd.c:289,294,966,999 pass job/partition names.

findings.title: HDD path-to-partition parsing exists three times (getHddParty, getHddDVRPParty, filer_mount getHddPartyFromPath)
findings.problem: getHddParty and getHddDVRPParty repeat the same fullpath build and partition split (22-30 vs 49-57) differing only in the prefix length (6 vs 10) and output prefix. filer_mount.c getHddPartyFromPath re-implements the hddN: check of getHddDeviceFromPath and the party split of getHddParty(path, NULL, party, NULL) for clipboardUsesHddParty.
findings.fix: Replace getHddPartyFromPath with a call to getHddParty(clipPath, NULL, clipParty, NULL) plus an empty-name check, and share the fullpath/split block of the two gui_hdd0_format.c functions through one static helper taking the prefix length.
findings.benefit: ~25 lines removed (18-line filer_mount copy plus ~8 shared lines); small .text saving (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read gui_hdd0_format.c:1-75 and filer_mount.c:190-217. getHddPartyFromPath is used only at filer_mount.c:214 (grep). getHddParty/getHddDVRPParty callers: filer.c, filer_browser.c, filer_actions.c, filer_copy.c (grep), all non-static use.

findings.title: GUI colour CNF parser hextou32 duplicates strtoul(value, NULL, 16)
findings.problem: hextou32 is a hand-written upper-case-only hex parser used by the eight GUI_Col_N_ABGR keys; strtoul is already linked (main_startup.c:291, cloud_http.c:538).
findings.fix: Delete hextou32 and use (u32)strtoul(value, NULL, 16); this also accepts lower-case hex. Adjust tests/test_classic_settings_persistence.py:55 which extracts the function by name.
findings.benefit: ~10 lines removed; tens of bytes of .text (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep hextou32: gui_colors.c:4,57-71 and the test only. Grep strtoul over src: main_startup.c:291, cloud_http.c:538,892.

findings.title: hddHeaderTextEditor global function pointer and editorForHeader wrapper for a single caller
findings.problem: The only caller of EditHddPartitionHeaderSystemCnf (dash_hdd.c:966) sets hddHeaderTextEditor to editorForHeader, which only forwards to dashTextEditor, and resets it to TextEditor afterwards; the TextEditor default is never used.
findings.fix: Call dashTextEditor directly from EditHddPartitionHeaderSystemCnf (or pass the editor as a parameter); delete the global, its extern, editorForHeader and the two assignments.
findings.benefit: ~9 lines removed; one global and one indirect call gone.
findings.evidence: Grep hddHeaderTextEditor over repo: hdd_header_injector.h:16, hdd_header_injector.c:826,858, dash_hdd.c:965,967. Grep EditHddPartitionHeaderSystemCnf: only dash_hdd.c:966. dashTextEditor(const char *) declared dash_internal.h:1067.
